answer: The echo counter is kept in beacon and dawn reveals each reset. Someone therefore has to keep each alias continuously active for 39 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 39 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 2804 identities would post 4185 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
